_comment: GENERATED once by the v2 planning session (2026-11-11) from the real import graph. One entry per legacy file: the module that will own it after the port. Files are only ever deleted from this map, never added. Read by scripts/arch/census.mjs.

src/lib/components/calendar/EventFormMod.note: Calendar keeps the event form. Task mode (taskSubmit, TaskQuickAddHelp, EventTaskFields, ChecklistSection) moves to the calendarPage screen as a wrapper that composes the event form with tasks' quick-add.

src/lib/components/calendar/EventModal.s.note: Drop the direct ChecklistSection import: give EventModal a `checklist?: Snippet` prop; screens pass tasks' checklist component.

src/lib/components/calendar/EventModalHe.note: Recurrence label (freqNoun) becomes calendar rule `describeRecurrence`; tasks imports it from calendar (dedupes taskDisplay.freqNoun, taskFeedback copy, TaskQuickAddPreview FREQ_NOUN).

src/lib/components/calendar/EventRecurre.note: Same as EventModalHeader: use calendar's `describeRecurrence`, not tasks' taskDisplay.

src/lib/server/db/actions/dashboard.ts.note: SPLIT: rankTop3/RankableTask/RankOpts -> tasks rules; getCompletionTimestamps/getRecurringDayCompletions/mergeDayCompletions -> tasks repo/service; getUserDayCalendar/getFamilyDayEvents/getKidsScheduleAttendance -> calendar repo/service; dayDashboard screen only composes.

src/lib/server/db/actions/events.ts.note: SPLIT: normalizeInvites/shiftException -> calendar rules; queries -> calendar repo; createEvent/updateEventById/deleteEventInScope/upsertException orchestration + access checks -> calendar service.

src/lib/server/db/schema.ts.note: Only re-exports BILL_CATEGORIES (no table uses it). Task K-04 splits tables into src/lib/kernel/db/tables/<module>.tables.ts and drops the re-export; bills owns the vocabulary.

src/lib/server/services/accountData.ts.note: SPLIT per section: settings/profile/sessions/api tokens -> identity; notification prefs -> alerts; subscription summary -> billing; dashboard module hides -> dashboardModules; consent history -> sponsored; account screen composes.

src/lib/server/services/autoBugReport.ts.note: feedback S5/S8: becomes the feedback fault-filing rules + service; then point src/lib/app/appCtx.server.ts faults and the hooks handleError at the feedback service, and delete this file.

src/lib/server/services/calendarData.ts.note: SPLIT: personal-calendar provisioning + family calendar info + event window reads -> calendar service; sponsored/verse/dashboard-module composition -> calendarPage screen load.

src/lib/server/services/dashboardData.ts.note: Composition stays in dayDashboard screen; every SQL query inside moves to the owning domain's repo.

src/lib/server/services/familyData.ts.note: SPLIT: member/role/member-type/invite/create use-cases -> family service; loadFamilyDetail/loadFamilyTasks read models -> familyHub screen; loadFamiliesOverview/loadInvitations -> family http.

src/lib/server/services/naturalLanguageS.note: SPLIT inside parsing by grammar family (event, bill, segment, place, time) around the existing claim book. NLP rule: phrase tables stay green, test-first.

src/lib/server/services/statsData.ts.note: Uses dashboard.ts getCompletionTimestamps: that reader moves into tasks (it reads taskCompletions).

src/lib/server/utils/apiError.ts.note: Used by ~22 legacy routes across modules. feedback S8: make it delegate to appCtx.faults.report (the feedback service) instead of building reports itself; delete it in APP-05 when the last legacy route using it is ported.
